## F — Consolidated VERIFY list

Open verification items for this section's dossier (guide signs, pavement markings, signals and roundabouts):
- sec09-A-EFFECTIVE-DATE — the manual prints its edition (November 2024, front cover) but no effective date.
- sec09-A-SCORING — question count, passing score and time limit not stated in the manual.
- sec09-A-FORMAT — knowledge test item format not described beyond automated delivery.
- AL-SEC-NINE-E-MARKET — market signal and competitor teardown not researched.
- sec09-G-PASSING — passing standard exactness cannot be met from the manual.
- sec09-G-MARKET — teardown and market pack boxes await sourced recon.
Every other fact in C and C2 of this section is page-cited with high confidence and carries no open debt.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
